newsitem.title: USA: Richmond Fed names new chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Richmond Fed names new chief financial officer.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond on Monday said it named a new chief financial officer, Michael Newton, who was promoted to senior vice president from his previous position of vice president.
Newton replaces Bruce Summers, who earlier this month left the financial officer post to become director of automation resources for the Federal Reserve system.
Newton has been with the Richmond Fed since 1974 and has held various management positions. He was most recently in charge of Reserve Accounts and Credit Division in the Financial Group.
He has also served in various roles supporting Federal Reserve system branch banking initiatives.
